description: Implementation of the AddressList class managing IP endpoints, DNS aliases, and related network address operations within the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: A class representing a list of IP endpoints with associated DNS aliases, supporting creation, manipulation, and deduplication of network addresses.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList with a single endpoint.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&, std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList with an endpoint and DNS aliases.

methods.name: AddressList(std::vector<IPEndPoint>)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList from a vector of endpoints.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress
methods.description: Creates AddressList from an IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates AddressList from a list of IPAddresses and DNS aliases.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo
methods.description: Creates AddressList from addrinfo struct pointer.

methods.name: CopyWithPort
methods.description: Copies an AddressList, replacing all endpoints' ports with specified port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets DNS alias to the string representation of the first endpoint without port.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases
methods.description: Sets DNS aliases, resetting if input is an empty string.

methods.name: AppendDnsAliases
methods.description: Appends additional DNS aliases to existing list.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of network log parameters including address list and aliases.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate IP endpoints from the list.
